newsitem.title: UK: Britain mulls sending troops to Zaire. [CORRECTED 01:22 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Britain mulls sending troops to Zaire. [CORRECTED 01:22 GMT]

text.p: Britain has put on hold its plans to send combat troops to eastern Zaire and will send a photo-reconnaissance plane to the war-torn country on Wednesday to assess the refugee crisis.

Foreign Secretary Malcolm Rifkind (corrects title from Defence Secretary) told BBC television news on Tuesday that humanitarian aid was needed to help Rwandan refugees in Zaire but it was not clear whether troops were necessary now that many refugees had returned home.
"What is much more uncertain is whether there continues to be a need for British military force," Rifkind said.
His comments followed news that the United States had changed its plans to send troops to Zaire and announced that less than 1,000 logistics personnel will go to aid refugees in Rwanda.
